notes: Both branches meet at Laith, so the names after him are the shared tail
«مولى ابن عباس» describes Abu Ma'bad and is not a link; «وقال لم يزل رسول الله يلبي» continues the same report with no transmitter of its own, so it is not a second group
«أبي، الزبير» is one man (kunya, comma, name; rule 7)
